children.game_version: 'Traffic Cop Glide' game where children mirror officer signals while gliding in right-outside pairs around a marked track.

seniors.counts: Count in steady 1-2, 1-2 pulse without fast syncopations.
seniors.seated_version: Perform upper-body frame holds and rhythmic foot taps in 2/4 ragtime tempo while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Execute slow-tempo forward walks in right-outside frame along a straight line with balance support.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce music tempo significantly and shorten stride length.

feedback_rules.description: Differentiating proper right-outside partner offset from standard closed ballroom hold.

learning_units.description: Mastering the right-outside frame alignment and gliding stride.

prerequisites.description: Ability to move at brisk tempos (>50 measures per minute) with spatial awareness along a ballroom line of dance.

social_formats.description: Traveling partner dance moving counterclockwise around a ballroom floor.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Partner hold offset to the right side (right-outside / English position).
movement_profile.footwork: Long, smooth gliding strides with occasional syncopations and quick directional changes.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Progressive partner travel covering large areas of the ballroom floor.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso frame with optional slight dipping motions of the upper body once rhythm is mastered.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to grounded level; continuous smooth gliding without airborne jumps.
movement_profile.partnering: Couple hold in right-outside position; leader navigates side changes and turns.
movement_profile.posture: Upright ballroom posture with upper body frame adapted for a right-outside (English) hold.

signature_moves.description: Continuous fast forward gliding strides taken while holding partner offset on the right side.
signature_moves.name: Right-Outside Glide

signature_moves.description: The leader changes side position while maintaining progress around the room.
signature_moves.name: Leader Side-Change Promenade

signature_moves.description: A subtle dipping motion of the upper body integrated into the continuous gliding movement.
signature_moves.name: Peabody Upper-Body Dip

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Extremely brisk, buoyant, smooth, and light-footed.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid heavy heel stomping, breaking frame in the right-outside hold, or stopping momentum on crowded floors.

music_profile.musical_form: Sectional ragtime, classic jazz, or big band arrangements.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Brisk ragtime or fast one-step beat with steady accents and optional syncopation.
music_profile.sound_description: A high-tempo ragtime or New Orleans jazz ensemble featuring fast, syncopated brass and piano drive that propels continuous rapid gliding movement.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: 100-120+ BPM (exceeding 50 measures per minute in 2/4 or 4/4)

basic_steps: Initiate forward progress with long, smooth, gliding strides around the room.
Execute simple promenade walks while maintaining right-side alignment.
Incorporate simple left and right turns along the floor pattern.
Add optional subtle upper-body dipping motions in tempo.
teaching.formation: Partner dance traveling counterclockwise along the perimeter line of dance in a right-outside hold.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners must master the right-outside frame and continuous forward gliding momentum before attempting syncopations, turns, or body dips.
teaching.rhythm: Fast 2/4 or 4/4 ragtime time, typically exceeding 50 measures per minute.
